name: flow_results_linger_keeps_party
description: A party match on a server ends (MATCH_END) and the player reads the results for 20 s before Play again. The plate keeps the connection alive (PING every 2 s, as in the hub and the match), so the server, which closes any connection silent for 15 s (silence_ms), keeps it and the party's row: Play again finds the party intact on the same connection (review M5 round 2).

steps.msg: twenty seconds on the results plate and the server still hears the connection

steps.assert: Session.client.get('_pings_out') - pings_at_end >= 9 and Session.client.phase_name() == 'ENDED' and Session.client.link.is_open()
steps.msg: the plate pings every 2 s on the open link
Play again said LEAVE_MATCH after MATCH_END: the server has my row back from the results plate

steps.assert: Session.state_name() == 'HUB' and Session.client == link_before and Session.client.phase_name() == 'WAITING'
steps.msg: back in the hub on the same connection
the party is intact: its code and both members

steps.assert: node('HubPanel').lines() == ['diamond Sascha lamplighter leader', 'circle Ana lookout', '+ invite', '+ invite']
